hook.name: SentryStockFeeHookV4
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for tokenized stock pools on Robinhood Chain that charges a time-decaying fee on the stock leg of every swap, splitting proceeds among holder reflections, creator, terminal pot, and growth sink. The pool LP fee is zeroed out; fees are taken entirely via hook deltas. Only the factory's LP vault may add liquidity.
